name: Daniel Mercer
summary: An analytical and technically minded Australian man interested in cloud security, artificial intelligence, practical innovation, outdoor activities, Christian faith and community projects. He values independence, reliability, honesty and substantive conversation.

preferences.definition: Demonstrating the knowledge and ability to handle technical work effectively.
A desire to ask questions and explore ideas to gain understanding.
Willingness to consider different ideas, evidence, and perspectives.
Principles used to consider what is right, responsible, and fair.
Putting religious trust and convictions into practice in everyday choices and actions.
Communicating truthfully and accurately, including when it is difficult.
Recognizing one’s limitations and valuing others without seeking superiority.
Discussing different views without insults, contempt, or dismissiveness.
Following through on plans and commitments consistently.
Interest in exploring, noticing, and learning about places and nature.
Taking other people’s comfort, needs, and limits into account.
